method: All 283 keys of the four namespaces read in full against the English source and its context sidecar: 115 ui.chat, 60 ui.chat.canonical, 82 ui.chat.run_details (including the new todos.hidden_summary) and 26 ui.chat.asks. Mechanical pass by script: key parity and order per namespace (0 missing, 0 extra, order identical); @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser AST fingerprint of every message with literals collapsed, so argument names/types, select and plural option sets, # counts and tag names were compared (0 structural differences across 283 keys); ur CLDR categories taken from Intl.PluralRules('ur') rather than assumed (one, other; 0→other, 1→one, 2,5,1000→other) and every plural site checked against them; rendered every plural message through IntlMessageFormat 12.1.3 with the ur locale at 0/1/2/5/1000. Byte pass: no RLM/LRM/FSI/PDI or U+202A-E/U+2066-9 characters, all values NFC, no edge whitespace except the deliberate trailing space in question_dock.hint.prefix, no Arabic-form letters (U+064A/0643/0647/0629/0649), no ASCII terminal punctuation after Urdu prose, no arrow glyphs, ellipsis form matches the source, kept-Latin tokens (AI, API, MCP, SVG, Mermaid, Canvas, Finder, Local Operator, Radient, Enter, Esc, yes/no/1/2, endpoint) untouched. Adjacency: read the join sites that concatenate fragments (error-block.tsx …before/link/…after with explicit spaces, question_dock prefix + body, composer-status-row jobs_action + code-owned jobClause) and the approval words module (approval-words.ts prints Approve/Deny and resolves yes/no/1/2), so the Latin approval words in ur are correct rather than untranslated. Fit: the two maxCells hints in the sidecars (session_status.choose_model 18, last_read 16) hold at 15 and 12 cells; no rendered frame or pixel measurement was taken in this run.

audit_notes_not_execution_log: This audit was scoped to catalogue bytes and ran no build and no app launch, so it took no rendered frame, pixel measurement or screenshot: every fit statement here is a codepoint count against the sidecar maxCells hints and the consuming component's own layout, never observed layout.

The TUI's bidi stance is treated as the documented render-layer limitation the ur guide records, not as a copy defect. In this app the document root and Radix provider take dir=rtl from i18n/languages.json, so strings that begin with a kept-Latin name (MCP …, Radient …, Local Operator …, Mermaid …, Canvas …, Finder …, SVG …) keep the source's order and are laid out by the RTL container; the per-string FSI/PDI isolation the guide describes applies to the terminal path, where 'legible-but-unordered' strings are a known degraded stance.
No manual bidi control was added by any translator: the byte scan found none in any of the four files.

findings.rendered: completed=1, total=5 renders «5 میں سے 1 باریاں»; completed=1, total=1 renders «1 میں سے 1 باریاں»
findings.problem: The message carries no plural arm, so باریاں is fixed, yet the noun follows the completed count and Urdu agreement takes the nearest numeral: at completed=1 the clause pairs a singular numeral with a plural noun («5 میں سے 1 باریاں», «1 میں سے 1 باریاں») — wrong agreement at the first turn of any loop, in a clause that is also the chip's accessible name.
findings.suggested: {completed, plural, one {{total, number, ::group-off} میں سے {completed, number, ::group-off} باری} other {{total, number, ::group-off} میں سے {completed, number, ::group-off} باریاں}} — needs an arm on completed in the English message; a ur-only workaround is a noun-free clause such as {total, number, ::group-off} میں سے {completed, number, ::group-off} مکمل.
findings.disposition: reported, non-gating (a minor does not block a passed round)

findings.rendered: count=1, kind=agents renders «ہب سے 1 ایجنٹوں کی اپ ڈیٹس سب اپ ڈیٹ کریں»; kind=teams renders «… 1 ٹیموں کی …»
findings.problem: The English message has no plural arm and the ur uses an oblique plural after the bare count, so count=1 reads «1 ایجنٹوں کی اپ ڈیٹس» / «1 ٹیموں کی اپ ڈیٹس» — a plural noun after a singular numeral, in an accessible name, at the most common single-update state. Not introduced by this round's remediation (round 1 passed the key).
findings.suggested: {count} ایجنٹ اپ ڈیٹس (compound noun, agreement-free) or «…کی تمام اپ ڈیٹس اپ ڈیٹ کریں»; the durable fix is plural arms on the English message.
findings.disposition: reported, non-gating; pre-existing, may be deferred to a later catalogue pass
